CREATE TABLE users (
            id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            username      TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,
            password_hash TEXT    NOT NULL,
            role          TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'player'
                          CHECK (role IN ('player', 'mod', 'dev')),
            is_banned      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            -- NULL with is_banned = 1 means permanent. See the migration.
            ban_expires_at INTEGER,
            ban_reason     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            banned_by      TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            banned_at      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            created_at    INTEGER NOT NULL
        , email TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', email_verified INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_chat_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, chat_tokens REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 8.0, last_world_image_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, deaths INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, name_hue INTEGER, last_image_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, failed_logins INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, lockout_until INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, chat_muted_until INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, chat_mute_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', chat_muted_by TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

CREATE TABLE staff_actions (
            id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            actor_id    INTEGER,
            actor_name  TEXT    NOT NULL,
            action      TEXT    NOT NULL,
            target_id   INTEGER,
            target_name TEXT    NOT NULL,
            detail      TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',

CREATE INDEX idx_staff_actions_actor_nc

CREATE TABLE sessions (
            token_hash   TEXT    PRIMARY KEY,

            expires_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,

            -- ONLINE_WINDOW_SECONDS: a session lives thirty days, so "has a
            -- session" says nothing about whether anyone is playing.
            last_seen_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, install_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, hardened INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, confirmed_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, confirm_misses INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, playing_slot INTEGER,
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

CREATE TABLE ended_sessions (
            token_hash TEXT    PRIMARY KEY,
            user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
            ended_at   INTEGER NOT NULL
        , why TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'elsewhere', install_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

CREATE TABLE account_ips (

            ip         TEXT    NOT NULL,
            first_seen INTEGER NOT NULL,

            FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

CREATE TABLE account_installs (
            user_id      INTEGER NOT NULL,
            install_hash TEXT    NOT NULL,
            first_seen   INTEGER NOT NULL,
            last_seen    INTEGER NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE login_attempts (

CREATE TABLE combat_kills (

CREATE TABLE position_samples (
            id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            at       INTEGER NOT NULL,
            user_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
            slot     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1,
            area     TEXT    NOT NULL,
            x        REAL    NOT NULL,
            y        REAL    NOT NULL
        )
CREATE INDEX idx_position_samples_user ON position_samples(user_id, slot, at)

CREATE TABLE presence_health (
            id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            at           INTEGER NOT NULL,
            seconds      REAL    NOT NULL,
            connections  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            players      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            areas        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            crowd        TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            ticks        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            late_ticks   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            frames_out   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            bytes_out    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            net_out      INTEGER,
            cpu          REAL,
            load1        REAL,

            month_used   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            month_from   INTEGER,
            affordable   REAL
        )

CREATE TABLE lusion_ledger (
            id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            at      INTEGER NOT NULL,
            user_id INTEGER,
            slot    INTEGER,
            delta   INTEGER NOT NULL,
            reason  TEXT    NOT NULL,
            detail  TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            -- SET NULL rather than CASCADE, same as gold_ledger: deleting a
            -- user must not rewrite the history of what existed.
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
        )

CREATE INDEX idx_lusion_ledger_user
            ON lusion_ledger(user_id, at)

CREATE INDEX idx_lusion_ledger_reason
            ON lusion_ledger(reason, at)

CREATE TABLE consume_grants (
            id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            slot    INTEGER NOT NULL,
            item_id TEXT    NOT NULL,
            -- WHICH POOL AND HOW MUCH, which the first version of this table
            -- could not record because the server did not know. `target` is
            -- ItemData.RestoreTarget by NAME ('HP', 'MANA', 'STAMINA', or ''
            -- for a revive, which fills all three).
            target  TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            amount  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            at      INTEGER NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

CREATE INDEX idx_consume_grants_char
            ON consume_grants(user_id, slot, at)

CREATE TABLE saves (
            user_id     INTEGER NOT NULL,
            slot        INTEGER NOT NULL,
            class_id    TEXT    NOT NULL,
            name        TEXT    NOT NULL,
            level       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            area        TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'elusion',
            hp          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
            max_hp      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
            mana        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
            max_mana    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
            stamina     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
            max_stamina INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
            gold        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            xp          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            xp_to_next  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,
            -- which pet this character currently has out, as the client's
            -- item_id (e.g. 'petpoisonslimesmall'). Empty string means none.
            -- Deliberately NOT validated against a list of known pets: the
            -- server has no item registry and inventing one here would mean
            -- every new pet the game adds needs a matching server deploy
            -- before it could be equipped. Same reasoning as bank item_ids.
            -- It IS checked against what the player holds: /api/save stores
            -- a pet only when the carry or the bank has it (_owns_item).
            active_pet_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            -- WHAT THIS CHARACTER IS WEARING, as a JSON object of item ids.
            -- Here for the same reason active_pet_id is: a string the client
            -- cannot keep for itself.
            --
            -- JSON IN A TEXT COLUMN, not eight columns. The server does not
            -- query inside it; it stores it, hands it back, and refuses ids the
            -- catalogue has never heard of. A column per equip slot would be a
            -- schema change every time a slot is added, to buy a query nobody
            -- writes.
            --
            -- There was a `hotbar` column beside this, holding which item id
            -- each key pointed at. The hotbar holds real items now - they are
            -- carry_items rows past the bag, see CARRY_CAPACITY - so the column
            -- is gone from the schema. A database created before that still has
            -- it, and nothing reads or writes it; it defaults to '[]'.
            equipment     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

            -- WHERE THIS CHARACTER HAS BEEN, as WorldMap's compressed
            -- exploration bitmask per area. Opaque to this server by design:
            -- knowing which tiles somebody has walked past confers nothing on
            -- anyone else, so there is nothing here to cheat and nothing worth
            -- the cost of understanding the format.
            --
            -- It is SIZE-CAPPED all the same. An opaque blob in a column with
            -- no ceiling is somewhere to put ten megabytes, and that is a
            -- different problem from cheating.
            explored      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            updated_at  INTEGER NOT NULL, last_kill_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, kill_tokens REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 20.0, last_train_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, pools_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_cast_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cast_tokens REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 6.0, resync_trade TEXT,
            PRIMARY KEY (user_id, slot),
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

CREATE TABLE accounts (
            user_id   INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            lusions   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (lusions >= 0),
            bank_gold INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (bank_gold >= 0),
            -- What dying has cost this account, cumulatively. Never decreases;
            -- see the migration for why it is account-shared rather than
            -- per-character.
            score     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (score >= 0),
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

CREATE TABLE carry_items (
            user_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
            slot     INTEGER NOT NULL,
            position INTEGER NOT NULL,
            item_id  TEXT    NOT NULL,
            quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
            PRIMARY KEY (user_id, slot, position),
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

CREATE TABLE skills (
            user_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
            slot     INTEGER NOT NULL,
            skill_id TEXT    NOT NULL,
            level    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (level > 0),
            xp       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (xp >= 0),
            PRIMARY KEY (user_id, slot, skill_id),
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

            token_hash   TEXT    PRIMARY KEY,

            role         TEXT    NOT NULL,
            created_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,
            last_used_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
            expires_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

CREATE INDEX idx_trusted_devices_user

            reason      TEXT    NOT NULL,
            level       INTEGER NOT NULL,
            gold        INTEGER NOT NULL,
            items       INTEGER NOT NULL,

            snapshot    TEXT    NOT NULL,

CREATE INDEX idx_save_snapshots_character

            at          INTEGER NOT NULL,
            actor_id    INTEGER,
            actor_name  TEXT    NOT NULL,
            user_id     INTEGER,

            slot        INTEGER,
            kind        TEXT    NOT NULL,
            item_id     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            quantity    INTEGER NOT NULL,
            gold        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            lusions     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

            sells_for   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

            ON gold_ledger(reason, at)

CREATE INDEX idx_gold_ledger_spent_reason
            ON gold_ledger(reason, delta) WHERE delta < 0

            key        TEXT    PRIMARY KEY,
            value      TEXT    NOT NULL,

        )

CREATE TABLE broadcasts (

CREATE TRIGGER trg_saves_gold_nonneg
        BEFORE UPDATE OF gold ON saves
        WHEN NEW.gold < 0
        BEGIN
            SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'gold cannot go below zero');
        END

        )

            bag_id   TEXT    NOT NULL,
            position INTEGER NOT NULL,
            item_id  TEXT    NOT NULL,
            quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
            PRIMARY KEY (bag_id, position),
            FOREIGN KEY (bag_id) REFERENCES loot_bags(bag_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

            session_hash TEXT    NOT NULL,

            identity     TEXT    NOT NULL,

        )

CREATE TABLE trade_holds (

            user_id     INTEGER NOT NULL,
            item_id     TEXT    NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE trades (
            trade_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            a_user      INTEGER NOT NULL,
            a_slot      INTEGER NOT NULL,
            a_gold      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (a_gold >= 0),
            a_confirmed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            b_user      INTEGER NOT NULL,
            b_slot      INTEGER NOT NULL,
            b_gold      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (b_gold >= 0),
            b_confirmed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            state       TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',
            created_at  INTEGER NOT NULL,
            updated_at  INTEGER NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, a_tax INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, b_tax INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            FOREIGN KEY (a_user) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            FOREIGN KEY (b_user) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )
CREATE INDEX idx_trades_a_recent ON trades(a_user, state, updated_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_trades_b_recent ON trades(b_user, state, updated_at)

CREATE INDEX idx_trades_cancelled ON trades(updated_at)
            WHERE state = 'cancelled'

CREATE TABLE trade_items (
            trade_id TEXT    NOT NULL,
            side     TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (side IN ('a', 'b')),
            item_id  TEXT    NOT NULL,
            quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
            PRIMARY KEY (trade_id, side, item_id),
            FOREIGN KEY (trade_id) REFERENCES trades(trade_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

CREATE TABLE character_deletions (
            id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
            slot       INTEGER NOT NULL,
            class_id   TEXT    NOT NULL,
            name       TEXT    NOT NULL,
            level      INTEGER NOT NULL,
            gold       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            deleted_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
            snapshot   TEXT    NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

CREATE INDEX idx_character_deletions_user
            ON character_deletions(user_id, deleted_at)

CREATE TABLE world_ticks (
            tick       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            element    INTEGER NOT NULL,
            started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
            ends_at    INTEGER NOT NULL,
            chosen_by  TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
        )

CREATE TABLE chat_messages (
            id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
            username   TEXT    NOT NULL,
            role       TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'player',
            body       TEXT    NOT NULL,
            created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
            -- WHICH CONVERSATION THIS LINE BELONGS TO.
            --
            -- ONE TABLE, NOT ONE PER CHANNEL. Every channel wants the same
            -- columns, the same flood bucket, the same "take that line down"
            -- and the same cursor; four tables would be four copies of all of
            -- it, and the fourth would be the one that forgot the moderation.
            --
            -- target_id IS READ DIFFERENTLY PER CHANNEL, which is the only
            -- awkward part of that choice and is worth the trade:
            --   world     unused, 0
            --   private   the account this was said TO
            --   friends   unused, 0 - the audience is the author's friend list
            --   guild     the guild, once guilds exist
            channel    TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'world',
            target_id  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            -- A RELAYED PICTURE, by id into chat_images. Empty for a line that
            -- is only words, which is nearly all of them.
            image_id   TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '', guild TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', name_hue INTEGER,
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )
CREATE INDEX idx_chat_channel ON chat_messages(channel, id)

CREATE INDEX idx_chat_private
            ON chat_messages(channel, user_id, target_id, id)

CREATE INDEX idx_chat_to
            ON chat_messages(channel, target_id, id)

CREATE TABLE chat_images (
            id         TEXT    PRIMARY KEY,
            kind       TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'still',
            width      INTEGER NOT NULL,
            height     INTEGER NOT NULL,
            frames     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            columns    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            frame_ms   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            bytes      INTEGER NOT NULL,
            source     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            created_by TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
            format     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'png',
            data       BLOB    NOT NULL
        )

CREATE TABLE chat_image_holders (
            image_id   TEXT    NOT NULL,
            user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
            created_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            PRIMARY KEY (image_id, user_id)
        )

CREATE TABLE chat_deletions (
            message_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            channel    TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'world',
            user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            target_id  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            deleted_at INTEGER NOT NULL
        )

CREATE TABLE ignores (
            user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
            ignored_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (user_id, ignored_id)
        )

CREATE TABLE chat_reports (
            id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            message_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
            reporter_id   INTEGER NOT NULL,
            reporter_name TEXT    NOT NULL,
            reported_id   INTEGER NOT NULL,
            reported_name TEXT    NOT NULL,
            channel       TEXT    NOT NULL,
            body          TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            image_id      TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            said_at       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            reason        TEXT    NOT NULL,
            created_at    INTEGER NOT NULL,
            resolved_at   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            resolved_by   TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            outcome       TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            UNIQUE (message_id, reporter_id)
        )

CREATE INDEX idx_chat_reports_open
            ON chat_reports(resolved_at, created_at)

CREATE INDEX idx_chat_reports_by
            ON chat_reports(reporter_id, created_at)

CREATE TABLE friends (
            requester_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            addressee_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            state        TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
                         CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'accepted')),
            created_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,
            decided_at   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            PRIMARY KEY (requester_id, addressee_id),
            FOREIGN KEY (requester_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            FOREIGN KEY (addressee_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

CREATE INDEX idx_friends_addressee
            ON friends(addressee_id, state)

CREATE INDEX idx_friends_requester
            ON friends(requester_id, state)

CREATE TABLE guilds (
            id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            name       TEXT    NOT NULL,
            folded     TEXT    NOT NULL,
            founded_by TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
        )

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_guilds_folded
            ON guilds(folded)

CREATE TABLE guild_members (
            user_id   INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            guild_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
            rank      TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member'
                      CHECK (rank IN ('leader', 'officer', 'member')),
            joined_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id)  REFERENCES users(id)  ON DELETE CASCADE,
            FOREIGN KEY (guild_id) REFERENCES guilds(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

CREATE INDEX idx_guild_members_guild
            ON guild_members(guild_id, rank)

CREATE TABLE guild_invites (
            guild_id   INTEGER NOT NULL,
            user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
            invited_by TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (guild_id, user_id),
            FOREIGN KEY (guild_id) REFERENCES guilds(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id)  REFERENCES users(id)  ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

CREATE TABLE guild_events (
            id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            at       INTEGER NOT NULL,
            kind     TEXT    NOT NULL,
            actor    TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            target   TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            detail   TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            FOREIGN KEY (guild_id) REFERENCES guilds(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

CREATE INDEX idx_guild_events_guild
            ON guild_events(guild_id, id)

CREATE TABLE parties (
            id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
        )

CREATE TABLE party_members (
            user_id   INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            party_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
            is_leader INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            joined_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id)  REFERENCES users(id)   ON DELETE CASCADE,
            FOREIGN KEY (party_id) REFERENCES parties(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

CREATE INDEX idx_party_members_party
            ON party_members(party_id, joined_at)

CREATE TABLE party_invites (
            user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
            from_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
            created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (user_id, from_id),
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            FOREIGN KEY (from_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

CREATE TABLE food_buffs (
            user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            slot    INTEGER NOT NULL,
            item_id TEXT    NOT NULL,
            kind    TEXT    NOT NULL,
            amount  INTEGER NOT NULL,
            ends_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (user_id, slot),
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

CREATE TABLE smith_ranks (
            user_id   INTEGER NOT NULL,
            slot      INTEGER NOT NULL,
            rank      INTEGER NOT NULL,
            earned_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (user_id, slot, rank),
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

CREATE TABLE economy_rules (
            key         TEXT    PRIMARY KEY,
            value       REAL    NOT NULL,
            updated_at  INTEGER NOT NULL,
            updated_by  TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
        )

CREATE TABLE economy_rule_changes (
            id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            at          INTEGER NOT NULL,
            key         TEXT    NOT NULL,
            old_value   REAL,
            new_value   REAL,
            by_id       INTEGER,
            by_name     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            FOREIGN KEY (by_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
        )

CREATE TABLE world_events (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name         TEXT    NOT NULL,
    kind         TEXT    NOT NULL,
    amount       REAL    NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,
    land         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    starts_at    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ends_at      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_by   TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    cancelled_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    cancelled_by TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    announced    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)
CREATE INDEX idx_world_events_window ON world_events(ends_at, starts_at)

CREATE TABLE online_samples (
    bucket   INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    at       INTEGER NOT NULL,
    everyone INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    players  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)
